تستحقري (form X)
# تَسْتَحْقِرِي (tastaḥqirī) /tas.taħ.qi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# تُسْتَحْقَرِي (tustaḥqarī) /tus.taħ.qa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
